title: Hailee Steinfeld Is a Witch in Her New Disney Movie 'Hexed'
summary:
Imagine finding out you have magical powers. That's exactly what happens to Billie Doe, the character Hailee Steinfeld voices in Disney's new animated movie, Hexed.

Steinfeld visited The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon to talk about it. "It's such a dream come true," she said. She started working on the film while she was pregnant and finished after her baby girl, Harper Haize, was born in April. "It was really such an amazing, transformative time in my life," she said.

Billie is a "rebellious, unconventional teen" who discovers she's a witch. Steinfeld calls Hexed a "magical coming of age story" about "learning to use that magic within you for good."

Hexed hits theaters this Thanksgiving. Steinfeld also had a huge year with the vampire movie Sinners, which earned 16 Oscar nominations — a record — and won four. She even watched the Oscars from home with a "bowl of popcorn and big belly."

Will she return to Marvel? "Time will tell," she teased.
why_it_matters: It reminds kids that the movies and shows they love are made by real people with busy lives — and that stories about finding your own power are popular because lots of people are searching for theirs.

Disney (a huge company that makes animated movies like Frozen and Moana, plus TV shows and theme parks) often makes movies about young characters who discover something special about themselves.

Article_Structure: WHO: Hailee Steinfeld, the actress and singer who voices Billie Doe, plus Billie herself — a rebellious teen witch — and Steinfeld's baby girl Harper Haize.
WHAT: Steinfeld talked about voicing Billie in Disney's new animated movie Hexed, a "magical coming of age story" about using the magic inside you for good.
WHERE: On The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, with Hexed hitting theaters this Thanksgiving.
WHY: It was a dream-come-true role during a huge year that also included Sinners earning 16 Oscar nominations and winning four.

perspectives.description: Fans are happy to see Steinfeld take on a fun animated role and say a story about a teen witch sounds perfect for a holiday movie.
Some viewers might say Disney keeps repeating the same idea — a young character who suddenly gets secret powers — instead of trying something new.
Looking at her year, Steinfeld shows how modern actors jump between animated voice roles, big award-winning films, and TV interviews all at once.
